note: Coshocton County publishes no zoning district layer; Ohio townships zone unincorporated land and the county GIS downloads list no zoning layer. The City of Coshocton, the only city zoning its land found, publishes its zoning only as a static 800-scale PDF map (districts R-1 through M-2), with no queryable service. ArcGIS searches for Coshocton zoning returned only parcels, floodplain, reference and an unrelated Alaska-extent 'Zoning_Districts' service (not Coshocton).
